$comment: Every deploy of apps/web/content/safe-install/presentation.v1.json, oldest first (new15 §14 可回滚性, PR P-7). Appended ONLY by `pnpm ledger:presentation:record`, never by a `:write` target and never by a workflow — a deploy workflow that committed here would be a new live writer, which PR P-7 is not licensed to add. This file is append-only by convention plus a duplicate refusal, NOT by cryptography: anyone with write access could rewrite it, the same limit five-second-panel-store.json has carried since new14. What makes an entry checkable is that it is RECOMPUTABLE — every recorded value must equal what presentationDigest() computes for the document at that entry's own commit, so a forged entry is a failing check rather than an unverifiable claim. deploys[0] is the predecessor: a real commit at which the catalog does not yet exist, so its digests are emptyPresentationDigest() and git proves the absence. Recording it as a commit rather than a sentinel gives rollback a floor reached by the same lookup as every other member. Seeded by deriving all values through presentationDigest over `git show`, never by transcription. Verify: pnpm ledger:presentation:validate
